measurement_notes: All 553 API NAR hashes are identical between IA and CA archive modes.
Closure copy sizes use local zstd level 3; they are not network timings. Final linking still requires full archives.
The archive union probe with configured remote caches issued per-output build-trace-v2 .doi queries for many minutes; the timing benchmarks explicitly disable remote queries.

An earlier unreported pilot rebuilt the CLI after a source test file changed mid-run. It is excluded; final timings above use a frozen checkout. The original pilot and explanation remain in /tmp/drvgo-export-data-ci.
The first draft CI run 43126099862 failed because offline tests preceded provisioning of pinned planner inputs. Test ordering was corrected at e900adc; no sandbox or correctness checks were removed.
